stem: What important military contribution did Navajo Code Talkers make during World War II?

options.label: A
options.text: They were part of a volunteer group of U.S. pilots that defended China from Japanese aggression.

options.label: B
options.text: They were one of the groups that transmitted secret military information in the Pacific Theater.

options.label: C
options.text: They were among the first black servicemen to fly as military aviators in the U.S. armed forces.

options.label: D
options.text: They were members of the tank division that helped liberate France after the invasion of Normandy.
